newsitem.title: UK: Weather shuts Russia's Novorossiisk oil port again.
newsitem.headline: Weather shuts Russia's Novorossiisk oil port again.

text.p: Russia's leading oil export terminal at Novorossiisk was shut early on Thursday because of high winds and swell after reopening late Wednesday following an 18-hour closure, a shipping source said.
The port, which handles the bulk of Russian oil exports to Europe, was closed at 0530 local time on Thursday after opening at 1635 on Wednesday.
One crude tanker was alongside berth two with a further five waiting at anchor outside the port.
Novorossiisk's biggest berth has been closed since December 9 for repairs and is not expected to reopen until December 24.
Other Black Sea outlets at Odessa and Tuapse were operating normally on Thursday but the Baltic port of Ventspils was closed due to high winds, the shipping source said.
